summary: Keep checkpoint status responsive while the current cut's identity digest is cold

rules.detail: Checkpoint identity hashing, agreement and retention rules are unchanged. Status participants come from already-sealed membership without sealing or judging pending local batches; maintenance keeps its normal sealing path.

compatibility.detail: Pending checkpoint status adds local_digest_state (ready or unavailable). Local terms use a valid warm digest or the node's own last published seal; terms is omitted when neither exists. The CLI and daemon ship together. During a mixed roll, an older CLI can fail to parse a cold status; retry after the roll. Explicit remote endpoints also need a compatible CLI. Maintenance, not status reads, computes cold identity digests.

recovery.detail: Rollback needs no data migration; older binaries resume synchronous status digest computation.
